message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: He signed a rental agreement with the actual car owner (郭某某) for a taxi, paying monthly rent. Then he, without the owner's knowledge, pretended to be the owner, signed a rental agreement with a victim (马某某) for the same car, collected rent and deposit (50600). Later the original owner reclaimed the car. Victim demanded rent and deposit, he refused. So he fraudulently obtained money by misrepresenting ownership, i.e., contract fraud (合同诈骗). The list includes "合同诈骗". Also possibly "诈骗" but they have separate label "诈骗". In examples, contract fraud is used for similar scenario: first example (contract fraud). So label: 合同诈骗.

Any other charges? He also maybe "侵占"? He didn't have the car, but he took money. The crime is fraud. The list includes "诈骗" (general fraud) and "合同诈骗" (contract fraud). The description: "在签订、履行合同过程中，采取虚构事实、隐瞒真相的手段，骗取他人财物". That's exactly contract fraud. So answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
